title: A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.01949v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that combines an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML) classifier for few shot malware detection. The AFE generates compact latent features that reduce noise and dimensionality, while the MAML classifier rapidly adapts to new threats using limited labeled data. translated_title: 一种恶意软件检测的混合方法：将少样本模型无关元学习与自编码器相集成
translated_abstract: 勒索软件已成为主要的网络安全威胁，其在关键领域的攻击事件发生频率和影响都在持续上升。这些攻击通常通过网络钓鱼邮件、恶意下载或利用软件漏洞来获取系统访问权限。一旦侵入系统，恶意软件便会对文件进行加密，并索要赎金（通常以加密货币形式支付）以换取解密密钥。传统检测方法在面对新型或样本稀缺的威胁时往往力不从心，使系统容易受到攻击。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种混合深度学习框架，将自编码器特征提取器（AFE）与模型无关元学习（MAML）分类器相结合，用于少样本恶意软件检测。AFE生成紧凑的潜在特征以降低噪声和维度，而MAML分类器则能利用有限的标注数据快速适应新的威胁。在Ransomware Dataset 2024数据集上进行的实验表明……
tldr: 本文提出一种将自编码器特征提取器（AFE）与模型无关元学习（MAML）分类器相结合的混合深度学习框架，能够在标注数据有限的情况下实现对勒索软件等新型恶意软件的少样本高效检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that integrates an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) classifier, enabling few-shot malware detection and rapid adaptation to novel ransomware threats with limited labeled data.
